notes: family: running-track. Prestige is gained during play (residence, actions, donations, Notre Dame at end of each period); score the 9th-round Notre Dame distribution before counting. Plague overflow costs 2 prestige each time (already reflected in tokens held). Tiebreak: gold + influence markers combined. Shared victory if still tied is an assumption (not stated).
